worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.summary: Spit a poisonous thread that wraps a foe, poisoning it and lowering its Speed; on a hit you may reel it in along the thread or pin it in place. The thread flies, so cover and footwork can dodge it.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.use.0: Get the drop on a fast target
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.use.1: Reel a charging melee threat out of position
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.use.2: Add a lasting poison to a stubborn foe
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.descriptio: A laced target loses %1$s Speed stage(s) and is poisoned for %2$s.
Reel distance or strength %1$s blocks, pin duration %2$s; %3$s thread strands are spat at once.
The thread flies at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s-block hit radius over %3$s blocks (range %4$s); windup %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.reel.on: Reel: on a hit, drag the target toward you along the thread to break its position or pull it into melee.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.reel.off: Pin: on a hit, freeze the target where it stands to hold it and open distance.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.toxicthread.preference: On drags the target toward you along the thread, good for pulling it into melee or breaking its position; off pins it in place to hold it and open distance. Neither changes the poison or the Speed drop.
The companion only considers spitting while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion may leave its post to spit under a Hold order.
world_combat.move.toxicthread.text.immun: Poison had no effect, but the thread still caught it
